data.content: What is the temporal coverage (min/max year) of mixture toxicity summaries stored on SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON relationships?

args.query: What is the temporal coverage (minimum and maximum year) of mixture toxicity summaries stored on SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON relationships?

data.content:
The results comprise 1 rows:
            
            <data>
            {"MinYear":{"0":1998},"MaxYear":{"0":2020}}
            </data>
            
            Provide the user with a Markdown formatted table of the data and a textual summary.
            <summary>
            {"MinYear":{"count":1.0,"mean":1998.0,"std":null,"min":1998.0,"25%":1998.0,"50%":1998.0,"75%":1998.0,"max":1998.0},"MaxYear":{"count":1.0,"mean":2020.0,"std":null,"min":2020.0,"25%":2020.0,"50%":2020.0,"75%":2020.0,"max":2020.0}}
            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (l:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(s:Species)
WHERE r.year IS NOT NULL
RETURN min(r.year) AS MinYear, max(r.year) AS MaxYear
            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding
            the full Neo4j graph database where the user can access the complete result with the cypher query.
data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
Here’s the temporal coverage of mixture toxicity summaries stored on SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON relationships:

| MinYear | MaxYear |
|---|---|
| 1998 | 2020 |

Summary:
- Mixture toxicity summaries (SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON, r.year not null) span from 1998 to 2020 (inclusive).

Cypher query used:
```
MATCH (l:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(s:Species)
WHERE r.year IS NOT NULL
RETURN min(r.year) AS MinYear, max(r.year) AS MaxYear
```

You can access the full Neo4j graph database and rerun this query using the Docker container at:
https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
